title: Australian Mousse Recipe
description: A light and airy dessert with the flavors of Australia. Perfect for warm weather and outdoor gatherings.
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat the cream over low heat until it starts to simmer.
Remove the cream from the heat and add in the chocolate. Let it sit for 1-2 minutes to melt.
Whisk the mixture until smooth and creamy.
Stir in the sugar and vanilla extract until combined.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
